title.es: Dentro de la fábrica de software agéntico de OpenAI

body.es: Un reportaje detallado revela que Codex pasó de adopción del 60% al 90% entre abril y mayo, y que su versión interna es más avanzada que la pública. El uso de IDEs ha caído desde enero mientras el número de pull requests por ingeniero crece de forma acelerada, y OpenAI depende tanto de Codex y Work que las alertas de caída se envían junto a los avisos automatizados. Esto sugiere un cambio estructural en cómo se construye software dentro de un laboratorio de IA de frontera, aunque el reporte se basa en entrevistas internas y no en datos públicos verificables de forma independiente.
body.en: A detailed report reveals Codex adoption surged from 60% to 90% between April and May, and that OpenAI's internal version is more advanced than the public one. IDE usage has been declining since January while pull requests per engineer grow at an accelerating rate, and OpenAI's dependence on Codex and Work is so deep that outage alerts go to colleagues alongside automated systems. This suggests a structural shift in how software gets built inside a frontier AI lab, though the report relies on internal interviews rather than independently verifiable public data.

evidence.claim: Codex usage surged from 60% to 90% between April and May.
OpenAI’s internal version of Codex is more advanced than its external counterpart.
IDE usage has been down since January when Codex usage started to surge.
The number of pull requests (PRs) per engineer is growing at a very high, accelerating rate.
OpenAI is fully dependent on Codex and Work, with internal messages from colleagues alerting the Codex and Work teams at the same time as automated alerts in the event of an outage.

title.es: iOS 27 y iOS 26.7 corrigen más de 100 fallos de seguridad
title.en: iOS 27 and iOS 26.7 fix more than 100 security bugs

body.es: Apple lanzó iOS 27 con parches para más de 100 vulnerabilidades de seguridad, mientras iOS 26.7 corrige más de 80, con 75 fallos compartidos entre ambas actualizaciones. Ninguna de las fallas se ha explotado activamente hasta ahora, pero los dispositivos sin actualizar quedan expuestos ahora que los detalles se han publicado.
body.en: Apple released iOS 27 with patches for over 100 security vulnerabilities, while iOS 26.7 fixes more than 80, with 75 flaws shared between both updates. None of the flaws are known to have been actively exploited so far, but unpatched devices are now exposed since the details have been published.

evidence.claim: iOS 27 update addresses over 100 security vulnerabilities.
iOS 26.7 has over 80 security fixes.
75 of the fixes are shared across both updates.
None of the flaws are known to have been actively exploited.

title.es: Apple Reference Image: un nuevo enfoque para fotografía verificada
title.en: Apple Reference Image: a new approach to verified photography

body.es: Apple presentó Apple Reference Image, un sistema que firma criptográficamente los datos de píxeles justo tras la captura mediante un arranque seguro del sensor, impidiendo que el firmware los modifique. El sistema aporta límites temporales inferior y superior verificados mediante el servicio de sellado criptográfico de Apple, y procesa la imagen final en Private Cloud Compute de forma segura y verificable, con capacidad de revocar fotos individuales o de un sensor completo si se compromete.
body.en: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image, a system that cryptographically signs pixel data immediately after capture via a secure sensor boot, preventing firmware from altering it. The system provides verified lower and upper capture-time bounds from Apple's cryptographic timestamp service, and processes the final image in Private Cloud Compute securely and verifiably, with the ability to revoke individual photos or all photos from a compromised sensor.

evidence.claim: Apple Reference Image ensures semantic authenticity by creating a secure digital negative that is cryptographically signed immediately after capture and preventing sensor firmware from modifying the data.
Apple Reference Image provides a proven lower and upper bound on capture time from Apple’s cryptographic timestamp service.
Apple Reference Image uses Private Cloud Compute to process the secure digital negative into a reference image, ensuring the processing steps are highly secure, private, and verifiable.
Apple Reference Image is designed to be resilient to compromise, including cryptographic attacks and hardware attacks, and can revoke individual photos or all photos from a specific sensor.

body.es: Swift 6.4 llega con Swift Build como sistema por defecto en Swift Package Manager, unificando cómo se compilan los proyectos en Linux, macOS y Windows. Subprocess alcanza la versión 1.0 estable para ejecutar e interactuar con otros programas, y WebAssembly corre hasta 40 veces más rápido mediante JavaScriptKit, además de mejoras de rendimiento con nuevos tipos de array no copiables y el protocolo Iterable.
body.en: Swift 6.4 arrives with Swift Build as the default in Swift Package Manager, unifying how projects build across Linux, macOS, and Windows. Subprocess reaches a stable 1.0 for running and interacting with other programs, and WebAssembly runs up to 40 times faster via JavaScriptKit, alongside performance gains from new non-copyable array types and the Iterable protocol.

evidence.claim: Swift 6.4 is now available.
Swift Build is now the default in Swift Package Manager.
Subprocess reaches 1.0, a stable, cross-platform way to run and interact with other programs from Swift.
Swift runs faster in the browser.
Performance improves while maintaining memory safety.

title.es: Lo que está en juego en la apuesta de un billón de dólares de la IA
title.en: What's at stake in AI's trillion-dollar gamble

body.es: Un análisis calcula que las hiperescaladoras podrían gastar cerca de $1.1 billones en centros de datos de IA para 2027, y que necesitarán multiplicar su propia productividad por 2.7 para 2030 solo para cubrir el costo de capital, un retorno del 15% y la depreciación de los activos. Los expertos citados advierten que la sostenibilidad de estas inversiones a cinco o diez años depende de que se materialicen ganancias de productividad en toda la economía, no solo en las propias empresas de IA.
body.en: An analysis estimates hyperscalers could spend nearly $1.1 trillion on AI data centers by 2027, and will need to roughly 2.7x their own productivity by 2030 just to cover the cost of capital, a 15% return, and asset depreciation. Cited experts warn that the sustainability of these investments over five to ten years depends on productivity gains materializing across the broader economy, not just within AI companies themselves.

evidence.claim: Hyperscalers are investing huge amounts of money to build AI data centers, with expenditures expected to reach nearly $1.1 trillion by 2027.
The AI companies will need to increase their own productivity by a factor of 2.7 to break even by 2030, accounting for the cost of capital and a 15% return, and depreciation of the assets.
The productivity growth across the economy will be crucial to achieving the required revenues for the AI investments to be sustainable over the next five to 10 years.

title.es: Tu agente superó la tarea. ¿Lo volverá a hacer?
title.en: Your agent aced the task. Will it do it again?

body.es: Un estudio muestra que un agente ReAct con GPT-4.1 en AppWorld tiene una brecha de consistencia de 24.4 puntos entre su tasa de éxito promedio (77.4%) y su tasa de éxito en las 5 repeticiones (53.0%). Un nuevo Consistency Analyzer, capaz de generar guías sin necesidad de repetir tareas completas, reduce esa brecha casi a la mitad, hasta 12.0 puntos, útil incluso en tráfico de producción donde repetir tareas no siempre es posible.
body.en: A study shows a ReAct agent using GPT-4.1 on AppWorld has a 24.4-point consistency gap between its average success rate (77.4%) and its rate of succeeding on all 5 repeated runs (53.0%). A new Consistency Analyzer, able to generate guidelines without re-running full tasks, cuts that gap nearly in half to 12.0 points, and is usable even on production traffic where replaying tasks end-to-end isn't always possible.

evidence.claim: The consistency gap between Mean@5 and Pass^5 for a ReAct agent using GPT-4.1 on AppWorld test_normal is 24.4 points.
The Consistency Analyzer can diagnose and generate guidelines to reduce the consistency gap without losing accuracy.
The consistency gap can be reduced by half using consistency guidelines generated by the Consistency Analyzer.
The Consistency Analyzer can be used on production traffic without re-running tasks end-to-end.

title.es: iPhone Duo: de las filtraciones a su presentación
title.en: iPhone Duo: from leaks to its unveiling

body.es: Un repaso histórico detalla que Apple contemplaba un iPhone plegable desde antes del primer móvil plegable comercial, el FlexPai, y que un viaje de Tim Cook por Asia en 2020 lo convenció de que la compañía debía entrar en ese mercado tras ver la adopción de plegables de Samsung y Huawei. Apple decidió el formato tipo pasaporte del iPhone Duo al menos dos años antes de que se lanzara el Galaxy Z Fold8, tras identificar el factor forma como una debilidad de la competencia.
body.en: A historical recap details that Apple had considered a foldable iPhone since before the first commercial foldable phone, the FlexPai, and that a 2020 trip by Tim Cook to Asia convinced him the company needed to enter that market after seeing adoption of Samsung and Huawei foldables. Apple settled on the passport-style form factor for the iPhone Duo at least two years before the Galaxy Z Fold8 launched, after identifying form factor as a weakness among competitors.

evidence.claim: Apple had been considering the idea of a plegable iPhone since before the first commercial plegable phone, the FlexPai.
Apple had not officially confirmed or denied the development of a plegable iPhone until recent years.
In 2020, Tim Cook's visit to Asia changed Apple's opinion on entering the plegable market.
Apple decided on the passport format for the iPhone Duo at least two years before the Galaxy Z Fold8 was released.

title.es: Jensen Huang: la IA no necesita regulación
title.en: Jensen Huang: AI doesn't need regulation

text.es: El CEO de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, argumenta que la IA no es una 'mente alienígena' sino simplemente hardware y software, por lo que la seguridad puede ser diseñada por cada fabricante sin necesidad de regulación externa.
text.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argues AI isn't some 'alien mind' but simply hardware and software, meaning safety can be engineered by each product maker without the need for external regulation.

evidence.claim: Jensen Huang believes AI is just hardware and software.

title.es: System One Models presenta Jev, un modelo que no puede alucinar
title.en: System One Models introduces Jev, a model that can't hallucinate

text.es: System One Models lanzó Jev, un modelo optimizado para salidas estructuradas que renuncia a la generación libre de texto pero, según la empresa, no puede alucinar y es dos órdenes de magnitud más rápido y eficiente que los LLM existentes, generando todas las probabilidades en paralelo en vez de token por token.
text.en: System One Models launched Jev, a model optimized for structured outputs that gives up free-text generation but, according to the company, cannot hallucinate and is two orders of magnitude faster and more efficient than existing LLMs, generating all probabilities in parallel instead of token by token.

evidence.claim: Jev is optimized for structured outputs and cannot hallucinate.
Jev is two orders of magnitude faster and more efficient than existing LLMs.
TypeSafe AI's Jev model outputs all probabilities in parallel, unlike autoregressive generation by token.
TypeSafe AI's Jev model is off the charts in workflow evaluations, owning the Pareto frontier for almost 2 orders of magnitude.

title.es: Cloudflare permite bloquear el entrenamiento de IA sin perder visibilidad en buscadores
title.en: Cloudflare lets sites block AI training without losing search visibility

text.es: Cloudflare presentó nuevos controles para que los propietarios de sitios web puedan seguir siendo indexables en buscadores mientras prohíben que sus contenidos se usen para entrenar modelos de IA.
text.en: Cloudflare introduced new controls letting website owners remain discoverable in search engines while disallowing their content from being used to train AI models.

evidence.claim: Cloudflare is providing new controls for site owners to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training.

title.es: El último iMac Intel de 21.5 pulgadas ya es 'producto vintage'
title.en: The final 21.5-inch Intel iMac is now a 'vintage product'

text.es: Apple clasificó el iMac Intel de 21.5 pulgadas de 2019 como 'producto vintage', categoría que aplica a productos descontinuados entre cinco y siete años; quedará oficialmente obsoleto en 2028, sin reparaciones oficiales, y probablemente permanecerá para siempre en macOS Sequoia, aunque Apple seguirá ofreciendo actualizaciones de seguridad hasta 2027.
text.en: Apple classified the 2019 21.5-inch Intel iMac as a 'vintage product,' a category applying to items discontinued for five to seven years; it will officially become obsolete in 2028 with no official repairs, and will likely remain stuck on macOS Sequoia forever, though Apple will continue offering security updates through 2027.

evidence.claim: Apple has classified the 2019 21.5-inch Intel iMac as a 'vintage product'.
Apple considers a product 'vintage' when it stopped distributing it for sale more than five years ago but less than seven years ago.
The 2019 21.5-inch iMac will officially be obsolete in 2028, meaning repairs will no longer be offered.
The 2019 21.5-inch iMac will likely forever be stuck on macOS Sequoia.

developer_signals.author: rasbt
developer_signals.original_text:
Some food for thought when designing benchmarks...

So, here's a little computer-use (visual) comparison between GPT-5.6 Astra and Qwen3.8 Max.

The task here was to recreate the image in the center using the Paint UI. 

Super interesting how the two different LLMs+Harnesses approached this totally differently by default.

I.e., Astra tried to approach this by drawing and layering geometric shapes. Qwen approached this pixel by pixel. (Of course, the pixel-by-pixel result looks closer to the original, it's essentially a low-res version of that by nature.)

So, the Qwen-generated image would surely score higher in the sense that it's closer to the original.

But I wouldn’t conclude from this example that one LLM generalizes better than the other on other tasks. Also, I wouldn't say Qwen has better compute-use capabilities or better visual understanding than Astra.

But it highlights an interesting point about how slippery benchmarks are when they only compare final results.

text.es: Sebastian Raschka comparó GPT-5.6 Astra y Qwen3.8 Max recreando una imagen en Paint: Astra dibujó capas de formas geométricas mientras Qwen trabajó píxel a píxel, y advierte que comparar solo el resultado final puede llevar a conclusiones erróneas sobre qué modelo generaliza mejor.
text.en: Sebastian Raschka compared GPT-5.6 Astra and Qwen3.8 Max recreating an image in Paint: Astra drew layered geometric shapes while Qwen worked pixel by pixel, and warns that comparing only final results can lead to misleading conclusions about which model generalizes better.
